clarity.notes: Workspace switching is now a single labeled trigger with a searchable command popover; Add workspace is an explicit quiet row directly below instead of a row lost inside a list.

hierarchy.notes: One anchor at the sidebar top (workspace selector), sessions own the remaining height. Status dots, state labels and timestamps pin to the title line instead of floating between lines.

typography.notes: Scale matches @agh/ui tokens: 13px small-body for trigger/options, 11px eyebrow for group heading and avatar initials (mono, 0.06em), 10px badge for the Home workspace tag.

motion.notes: Popover uses the production 140ms scale(0.96)+fade with ease-out; running sessions get a subtle 2.6s ring pulse scoped to session rows; global prefers-reduced-motion guard covers both.

brand.notes: Geometry transcribed 1:1 from CommandSelect/Command/Popover primitives and workspace-command-select.tsx; runtime token ramp only, accent budget untouched (no new accent surfaces).
